pd: Pd is a silver-white metallic element of the platinum group that resembles platinum.
Pd means the same as palladium or atomic number 46.
pda: PDA is a lightweight consumer electronic device that looks like a hand-held computer but instead performs specific tasks.
PDA means the same as personal digital assistant or personal organizer or personal organiser.
pdflp: PDFLP is a Marxist-Leninist group that believes Palestinian goals can only be achieved by revolutionary change.
For example: "In 1974 the DFLP took over a schoolhouse and massacred Israeli schoolchildren."
PDFLP means the same as Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine or DFLP or Popular Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine.
pdl: A pdl is a unit of force equal to the force that imparts an acceleration of 1 foot/sec/sec to a mass of 1 pound.
Pdl means the same as poundal.
